# vercel_project_speed_insights (Resource)

Provides a Project Speed Insights resource.

Speed Insights collects Core Web Vitals and other performance metrics from a project's deployments. For more detail, see the [Speed Insights documentation](https://vercel.com/docs/speed-insights).

Enabling Speed Insights is available on Pro and Enterprise plans and may incur charges on your account.

Deleting this resource disables Speed Insights for the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vercel_project" "example" {
  name = "example-project"
}

resource "vercel_project_speed_insights" "example" {
  project_id = vercel_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Project to enable Speed Insights for.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team the Project exists under. Required when configuring a team resource if a default team has not been set in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Project Speed Insights can be imported by specifying the project ID.
terraform import vercel_project_speed_insights.example prj_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

# Alternatively, specify the team ID and project ID.
terraform import vercel_project_speed_insights.example team_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/prj_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
